description: Read one work on IMSLP: its title and alternative titles, the composer, the opus and catalogue numbers, the year it was written and the year it was first published, the dedication, the key, the instrumentation, the style and period, and how many scores and recordings the page holds. Address a work by its page title, written 'Work (Composer)', for example 'Nocturnes, Op.9 (Chopin, Frédéric)', or by the page id. Dates and durations come back in the wording the page used: 'ca.1830' stays 'ca.1830', because a bare year would state a certainty the library declined to state. A facet the page leaves empty comes back null rather than guessed. A work holding a few editions comes back with them, files included. One holding many comes back with 'editions' null and 'editions_truncated' true, and list_work_files pages through them. The copyright of a score is stated per jurisdiction: 'Public Domain - Non-PD US' is free in Canada and the European Union and protected in the United States, so never report a score as public domain without saying where. No score file is downloaded or linked; the work page is what an answer links to. When you show a work to a user, credit IMSLP and link that page.

page.description: The title of the work's page, written 'Work (Composer)', for example 'Nocturnes, Op.9 (Chopin, Frédéric)'. Pass this or 'pageid', not both.

pageid.description: The page id a search returns. Pass this or 'page', not both.

name: get_work

authorities.description: Records of the work in library catalogues: VIAF, LCCN, WorldCat, BNF, GND.

id.description: The identifier in that register, when it names one.

copyright_summary.description: The terms the scores of this work are published under, one entry per distinct statement, with the number of editions on the page carrying it. Stated whether or not the editions themselves fit in this answer.

headline.description: What the statement leads with, for example 'Public Domain'.

remark.description: A remark the library wrote beside the statement, for example 'See notes on copyright status for urtext editions'. It qualifies the terms without naming a place.

restrictions.description: The jurisdictions the statement excludes, for example 'Non-PD US'. Empty when it excludes none, which is not a claim about countries IMSLP does not review.

reviewed_in.description: Where IMSLP checks copyright: Canada, the United States and the European Union.

statement.description: The statement as IMSLP publishes it.

headline.description: What the statement leads with, for example 'Public Domain'.

remark.description: A remark the library wrote beside the statement, for example 'See notes on copyright status for urtext editions'. It qualifies the terms without naming a place.

restrictions.description: The jurisdictions the statement excludes, for example 'Non-PD US'. Empty when it excludes none, which is not a claim about countries IMSLP does not review.

reviewed_in.description: Where IMSLP checks copyright: Canada, the United States and the European Union.

statement.description: The statement as IMSLP publishes it.

blocked.description: True when IMSLP has suspended access to this file, which it does while reviewing the copyright of one. Never report such a file as available.

blocked_reason.description: What the library says about the suspension, as published. Null when none applies.

description.description: What the entry is called, for example 'Complete Score'.

downloads.description: Null when the entry prints no counter, which is not a count of zero.

format.description: The format as the page writes it: 'PDF' on a score, 'MP3 file' on a recording.

format_code.description: The same format without the noun the library appends to a recording: 'PDF', 'MP3', 'MID', 'ZIP', 'FLAC', 'MP4'. Filter on this rather than on the published wording.

page_url.description: The work page. The file itself is never linked.

rating.description: Null when nobody has voted, since the page then prints 0.0 out of 10.

scanned_by_code.description: The RISM sigla of the library that scanned it, for example 'US-R'.

misc_notes.description: A note an editor typed, quoted as published.

section.description: The section of the page it sits in, for example 'Scores'.

editions.description: Every edition the page holds, files included. Null when the work holds more of them than one answer carries, and list_work_files then pages through them.

pageid.description: The number IMSLP gives the page. Known when the work was addressed by it, and null when it was addressed by title: a rendered page states its title and nothing else.

redirected_from.description: The title asked for, when it redirected here.

sections.description: The sections of the page, with the number of entries the site counts in each.

title: Read a work
